title: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
description: Nuclei spinning in a strong field answer radio at a frequency set by the field and their surroundings: the whole shape of a molecule, atom by atom. Unlocks the NMR Spectrometer.

puzzle.goal: A nucleus with gyromagnetic ratio g sits in a field B. Write the frequency f it precesses at, in hertz.
puzzle.name: Larmor
puzzle.ask: Find f for a proton, g = @{g} rad/(s·T), in B = @{B} T.
puzzle.method: The magnetic moment precesses round the field like a top under gravity, at ω = γB.
